title: Truncated Labels with Tooltips
description: One row where $truncate on BreadcrumbLabel clips the two middle steps, longest first, and the first and current steps stay whole. Each clipped label renders through TruncatedText inside a Tooltip on its link, so the tooltip shows the full text on hover and keyboard focus only while the label is clipped. Use it in a tight header that must stay one row high, and use the scrolling trail when every label must stay whole.
